chunks: If you ask them: 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They will surely answer: 'God.' Say: 'All praise be to God.' But most of them do not understand.
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists of Mecca acknowledge Allah as Creator but still associate partners with Him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinction between mere intellectual acknowledgment (Ilm al-Jahri) and true, actionable gnosis (Ma'rifah) required for monotheism. It critiques the polytheists' failure to derive the logical consequence of Allah's sole creation—exclusive worship—highlighting that their 'ignorance' was a willful neglect of their innate knowledge. This serves as a foundational argument for the necessity of aligning belief with practice, a key theme in Shia theological discourse.
